name: Cabo Rojo (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Blue field with a dark red triangle fimbriated in white issuing from the hoist and reaching to the fly, after the municipal arms.
history: Cabo Rojo is a city and municipality on the southwest coast of Puerto Rico. The flag takes its elements from the coat of arms, omitting the sword, the anchors and the crown.

features.role: red triangle reaching to the fly, fimbriated in white
